text: Done. Security check result: page scripts can reach this data on any routed hostname, because /__devhost__ shares the application's origin and the control API has no token. So the view is a page on the control server's own 127.0.0.1:<port> origin, which refuses routed hosts and proxied clients; the WebSocket also has the origin check. agent-watcher gained Config.StartAtEnd and Config.SessionFilter (e585504). Real-machine probe filtered to this checkout: 1 lifecycle event and no replay, against the 75,346 events this ticket measured, with 361 MB allocated against 4.7 GB. Known limit: a session resumed after the page opens replays that session's history.
